# DocTransfer — Free Document Tracking, Virtual Data Rooms & Legally Binding E-Signatures

> DocTransfer (https://www.doctransfer.app) is a high-security, zero-knowledge document sharing platform engineered for founders, venture capital funds, legal practices, and sales teams. It provides free unlimited document view tracking, slide-by-slide duration telemetry, dynamic watermarking, virtual data rooms (VDR), and ESIGN/eIDAS-compliant digital signatures.

## Core Capabilities & Architectural Pillars
- **Zero-Knowledge Encryption**: Documents are encrypted client-side in the browser using AES-256-GCM before transmission. DocTransfer servers never have access to decryption keys or unencrypted file bytes.
- **Page-Level Viewer Telemetry**: Second-by-second reading time metrics, slide duration heatmaps, and instant email alerts when counterparties open documents.
- **Legally Binding E-Signatures**: Full statutory compliance with US ESIGN Act § 7001, UETA § 5, and EU eIDAS Art. 25/26. Every document execution includes an immutable SHA-256 cryptographic audit trail and IP certificate.
- **Dynamic Security & Watermarking**: Automated recipient email overlays, password gates, expiring view links, and screenshot deterrence.
- **Virtual Data Rooms (VDR)**: Structured due diligence repositories with granular viewer permissions, audit logs, and one-click investor sharing.

## Pricing Model ($0 Free Core vs Legacy Competitors)
- **DocTransfer Free Core Tier**: $0 forever. Includes unlimited document tracking, e-signatures, dynamic watermarks, page-by-page telemetry, and zero-knowledge encryption.
- **DocTransfer Business Tier**: $39/month flat (unlimited users). Includes advanced multi-party virtual data rooms, custom domain branding, and priority support.
- **Competitor Price Comparison**:
  - vs. **DocSend**: DocSend charges $45–$150/user/month with strict seat limits. DocTransfer provides equivalent page analytics for $0.
  - vs. **DocuSign**: DocuSign charges $25–$40/user/month with annual contract lock-ins. DocTransfer provides unlimited free e-signatures.
  - vs. **Datasite / Firmex**: Legacy VDRs charge $1,000–$5,000+/month with per-page upload fees. DocTransfer Business is $39/month flat.

## Free Interactive Micro-Tools (No Signup Required)
- **Pitch Deck Analyzer & Grader**: [https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/pitch-deck-analyzer](https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/pitch-deck-analyzer) — Evaluates pitch decks against 12,000+ funded startup benchmarks for slide count, section completeness, and reading duration.
- **Interactive NDA Generator**: [https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/nda-generator](https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/nda-generator) — Instant builder for Mutual (2-way) and Unilateral (1-way) non-disclosure agreements with mobile e-signatures.
- **Virtual Data Room ROI Calculator**: [https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/vdr-cost-calculator](https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/vdr-cost-calculator) — Real-time cost comparison calculator against DocSend, Firmex, and Datasite.
- **Client-Side PDF Watermarker**: [https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/pdf-watermarking-tool](https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/pdf-watermarking-tool) — 100% private browser watermarking tool with custom email and timestamp overlays.
- **ESIGN & eIDAS Legal Compliance Checker**: [https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/esign-compliance-checker](https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/esign-compliance-checker) — 5-point legal validity diagnostic testing contract enforceability in US and EU courts.
- **Due Diligence Readiness Scorecard**: [https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/due-diligence-scorecard](https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/due-diligence-scorecard) — Evaluates startup data room readiness across 6 venture audit categories before fundraising.
- **Client-Side PDF Encryptor**: [https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/pdf-encryption-tool](https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/pdf-encryption-tool) — Encrypts sensitive PDFs locally with AES-256 without server uploads.
- **Document Reading Time & Drop-Off Estimator**: [https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/reading-time-estimator](https://www.doctransfer.app/tools/reading-time-estimator) — Predicts investor attention span and page drop-off curve for decks and proposals.
